OKAFOR STRATEGIC CONSULTING
Partial Substantiation Records — Vehicle and Home Office Expense
Assembled for IRS Appeals conference, February 2025

  Total logged miles, July–December 2022: 243 business miles
  (No contemporaneous log exists for January–June 2022; taxpayer states a
  paper log from that period was lost during a home office move in August 2022.)

  At the 2022 standard mileage rate of $0.585/mile for Jan 1–Jun 30 and
  $0.625/mile for Jul 1–Dec 31, the substantiated July–December miles alone
  support approximately $152 of the $9,800 originally claimed. Full-year
  claimed mileage was approximately 15,700 miles; only the partial log above
  can currently be corroborated.

HOME OFFICE

  Claimed home office: 220 sq ft of a 2,100 sq ft residence (10.5% of home),
  used exclusively as of March 2022 (home office was set up mid-year;
  original claim of a full 2022 deduction did not account for this).

  Corrected calculation (10 months at 10.5%, per simplified method,
  $5/sq ft, capped at 300 sq ft): 220 sq ft x $5 x (10/12) = $916.67

  This corrected figure ($917) is substantially less than the $4,200
  originally claimed for a full 12 months of home office use.

CONTRACT LABOR

  No Forms 1099-NEC were issued to either individual paid as contract labor
  during 2022 (Ana Delgado, $2,600; Ray Chittenden, $1,800). Petitioners
  concede no substantiation currently exists for this $4,400 item beyond
  cancelled checks, which have been requested from the bank but not yet
  received as of this filing.
